title: Greetings and responses
label: ch:urdu-greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Urdu, respond courteously, and close the exchange naturally. I can also write the three shapes inside shukriyā and the letter sīn from memory.

payoff.summary: Complete UR-C01-nahin, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: greet someone in Urdu, respond courteously, and close the exchange naturally, then pick out shīn, kāf and re and write one sīn.
payoff.note: UR-C01-nahin assesses all fourteen atoms the chapter introduces: it retrieves the courteous yes-and-thank-you exchange, rebuilds nahin from ye, he and nasal nūn ghunna plus the new nūn, contrasts it with jī hā̃, then a closing say-it-back recalls salām, picks out shīn, kāf and re out of order, and writes one sīn.
